description: 178 olive-harvest-related attacks across 88 communities in October and November 2025. Between 1 October and 3 November alone, 150 harvest attacks injured more than 140 Palestinians and damaged over 4,200 trees and saplings across 77 villages. Up to 2023 OCHA recorded roughly 30 to 60 incidents a season.
energy_note: Four thousand trees, in five weeks.

aspect: EXAMPLE - Tarqumiya: 500 dunums of 5,000, for one day
description: Where army permits are required to reach the land, coordination came very late and for one or two days only. In Tarqumiya, access was granted for a single day covering 500 of over 5,000 previously accessible dunums. In Bani Na'im, accessible land fell from about 150 dunums to 12.
money_note: Value of a harvest that could not be picked.
energy_note: One day, one tenth of the grove, and the rest rots.

aspect: An olive tree is a thirty-year asset
description: A burned or uprooted tree is not a season's loss. Replacement takes a decade to bear and a generation to mature, so the damage is priced wrongly by everyone who records it as annual.
money_note: Per tree, over its productive life.

aspect: It is a family and female labour economy
description: The harvest is the one agricultural activity involving the whole household, women prominently. Losing access removes an income, a food source, and the annual event around which the extended family assembles.
energy_note: Losing the harvest and the family gathering with it.
